finalText:
All steps of the workflow succeeded, exercising Newick I/O (parser 1), inspection, pruning, midpoint rerooting, and Robinson-Foulds comparison under the pinned ETE 4.4.0 runtime.

VERDICT: DONE
Using the bundled `tree_operations.py` script under a pinned `ete4==4.4.0` uv runtime, I produced `pruned.nw` and `rooted.nw` (and source trees `tree.nw`/`tree_b.nw` plus `keep.txt`) in the working directory, verified via stats/ascii inspection, and measured a normalized unrooted Robinson-Foulds distance of 1.0 (rf=2/2) between the two 4-leaf topologies.
